title: lazyagent protocol v1 method params and results
description: Definitions named '<method>.params' and '<method>.result': the ten methods inherited from the legacy IPC server, then the v1 additions. Fields marked 'v1' are additions the legacy server does not send.

agent_status.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

confidence.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

agent_id.description: Optional selector: may be omitted when the worktree has exactly one agent.

agent_status.description: Roll-up over agents, kept for back-compat.

git_status.description: Present once the status has been computed.

base_branch.description: Default: the configured default_branch when a worktree has it checked out, else the main worktree's branch.

extra.description: Only used by a configured custom create command.

env.description: Environment of a custom command this call runs (the client's, D5); the engine's own when omitted.

custom_command.description: True when a custom create command ran; path is then predicted.

job_id.description: v1: custom create runs as an engine job (job.output / job.finished).

custom.description: Run the configured custom remove command as an engine job instead of git worktree remove, as the TUI does.

env.description: Environment of a custom command this call runs (the client's, D5); the engine's own when omitted.

job_id.description: v1: custom remove runs as an engine job.

spawn_agent.params.description: worktree_path is required for kind 'agent' and ignored for 'orchestrator'.

env.description: v1: environment of the calling client; the agent inherits it.

notes_mode.description: How the agent may write its session notes; default: [notes] mode. Orchestrator workers get free.

review_comment_ids.description: The review comments in the instruction (review_register's comment_ids), registered for the new agent before it starts.

caller.description: The spawning agent's token, when an agent (the orchestrator included) asks: [orchestrator] max_spawns_per_day and max_concurrent_agents then apply, and a spawn over either is a VALIDATION_ERROR naming it. No token: the user, uncapped.

cursor.description: list_events cursor taken before the spawn.

notes.description: The agent's session notes: deleted, or kept as an orphan (orphan_days) that notes_adopt can recover.
The agent's final session notes, when not empty: the handoff of a caller with no UI to offer one.

delivery.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

since.description: Replay the events after this seq first; omitted or null means from now.

events.description: Only these event names; omitted or null means all. A later subscribe replaces the filter.

cursor.description: seq of the newest event when the subscription started; live events are after it.

replayed.description: How many history events follow the response, before the live ones.

truncated.description: True when events after since were already evicted from the history.

unsubscribed.description: False when there was no subscription.

from_offset.description: Resume point: offset after the last byte the client has.

stream_id.description: Per connection; output and input frames carry it.

mode.description: tail: output frames resume at from_offset. snapshot: render 'snapshot' into an empty terminal of 'size', then the output frames from 'offset'.

offset.description: Offset of the first output frame that follows.

snapshot.description: mode snapshot only: ANSI that rebuilds the screen and capped scrollback as of 'offset'.

rows.description: With cols: claim and resize in one step.

owner.description: Whether the caller owns the session's size.

env.description: Environment of a shell started by this call; ignored when it already runs.

paths.description: Omitted or null means every worktree.

base.description: U5: diff from the merge-base of this branch (or commit) and HEAD to the working tree, so committed work shows too. VALIDATION_ERROR when there is no merge-base. Default: the working tree against the index, as the TUI's tab.

max_bytes.description: U5: the cap instead of the default 64 KiB, up to 4 MiB (4194304); more is a VALIDATION_ERROR.

pr.description: The diff the branch's pull request shows (GitHub's Files changed): 'diff' is merge-base(base, HEAD)..HEAD, committed work only, and 'uncommitted' is HEAD against the working tree plus untracked files. Without 'base' the base is resolved (see the result's 'base'); 'base' is used as given, VALIDATION_ERROR when it has no merge-base.

fetch.description: With 'pr' only: 'git fetch origin <base branch>' in the worktree first, and refresh its PR info (a resolved base, or an 'origin/…' one). A failed fetch is reported as 'fetch_error', not an error.

diff.description: Capped like the TUI's diff tab. With 'pr', the committed part only.

uncommitted.description: With 'pr': staged, unstaged and untracked changes (HEAD against the working tree). It shares the cap with 'diff': each gets at least half.

base.description: With 'pr': what 'diff' is against; null when no base could be used (then 'diff' is empty and 'base_error' says why).

ref.description: The ref diffed against, e.g. origin/feature-x: origin/<branch> when that exists, else the local branch; an override as given.

branch.description: The branch it was resolved from; null for an override.

source.description: pr (the open PR's base branch), default (the configured default branch, else the main worktree's), override (the 'base' param).

refresh.description: Fetch even when a cached answer exists.

fetched.description: False when no answer could be fetched (no gh); pr_info is then null.

interest.description: The union over every client, which the pollers use.

agents.description: Empty or the one orchestrator agent (agent_id "").

pr_info.description: Worktree path -> PR info (null: no PR), for the worktrees fetched so far.

git_statuses.description: Worktree path -> full git status, for the worktrees computed so far (worktrees only carries the counts).

cursor.description: subscribe {since: cursor} continues from this state without a gap.

worktree_path.description: The worktree shown; null when the orchestrator or nothing is.

agent_id.description: The agent whose terminal is the active tab (the orchestrator's is ""); null when none is.

focus.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

modal.description: The open modal (spawn, create, remove, help, …) while focus is modal; else null.

seq.description: seq of the ui.command event the hosted UI acts on.

worktree_path.description: The resolved target; null is the orchestrator.

ui_target.description: true targets the orchestrator instead of a worktree.

attach_ui.params.description: Make this connection a hosted UI (a TUI on a remote engine): the ui.* commands are offered while one is attached. Dropped by detach_ui or on disconnect.

publish_view.params.description: A UI announces what it shows; emitted as ui.view_changed unless equal to the last view.

published.description: False when the view equals the last one announced.

shutdown.params.description: Stop a detached engine once the reply is sent (lazyagent engine stop). An engine inside a TUI answers VALIDATION_ERROR.

stop_agents.description: false: only stop an engine that runs no agent (VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise). An agent cannot outlive its engine: its PTY closes.

agents.description: Agents (the orchestrator included) stopped with the engine.

restorable_agent.description: An agent an earlier engine ran when it ended, from the restart manifest.

id.description: Opaque; what restore_agents and dismiss_restorable take.

worktree_path.description: The orchestrator's key for kind orchestrator.

conversation_id.description: The provider's conversation id when it reported one; a restore resumes exactly it, else the provider's last conversation.

instruction.description: The last instruction sent to it, when known (first 4,096 characters).

notes_id.description: Its session notes, carried to the restored agent (proposal 0011); null when it has none.

env.description: The environment the agents start from (the calling client's, D5); default: the engine's.

notes_mode.description: manual: the agent writes only when the user asks (advisory); propose: its writes are proposals (behaves as manual until propose lands); free: it writes directly.

notes_by.description: Who wrote last; null for the untouched template.

notes_caller.description: The calling agent's token (LAZYAGENT_AGENT_TOKEN in its MCP server's env). Without worktree_path the target is the caller's own notes. Another agent's token may read but not write; the orchestrator's token writes as the orchestrator, no token as the user.

max_bytes.description: A write above it is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR: condense them).

notes_id.description: Any notes by id (an ended agent's too), instead of a target.

instruction.description: The pinned instruction (the agent's first prompt), read-only.

if_rev.description: The rev the edit started from; a stale one is a CONFLICT carrying the current {rev, text}.

section.description: A '## ' heading name, matched case-insensitively; created at the end when missing.

text.description: Each line becomes a list item ('- ') unless it already is one or is indented.
The section's new body, up to the next '## ' heading.

worktree_path.description: Only this worktree's (the orchestrator's key for its notes).

expires_at.description: When an orphan is deleted; null for the others.

notes_id.description: Ended notes (orphan or restorable) to recover.

worktree_path.description: The live agent that takes them (its text is replaced).

if_rev.description: The live notes' rev; a stale one is a CONFLICT.

notes_id.description: Ended notes; a live agent's go with it (stop_agent).

review_reply_item.description: An agent's answer to one review comment (review_reply).

agent_id.description: A live agent there: the one the comments were sent to.

comment_ids.description: The ids its prompt gives (at most 64 letters, digits, - or _); a comment sent again (a follow-up, another agent) keeps every agent it went to.

caller.description: The answering agent's token (LAZYAGENT_AGENT_TOKEN): required; the comment must have been registered for that agent.

status_row.description: One work item (proposal 0013): a branch with its worktree, agents and PR, projected by the engine; nothing in it is stored.

title.description: The PR title, else the branch.

zone.description: inbox: the ball is the user's.

level.description: Inbox rows only. now: an agent is blocked on the user.

state.description: A fact in at most five words, e.g. 'review requested, CI green'.

blocks_agent.description: An agent waits on the user's answer: first in its level.

needs_you.description: The work item's open inbox items (actionables_list); null when it has none.

top.description: The first item's id, in the queue's order.

since.description: When it took this status (Unix time).

note.description: The first open Pending item, else the last Doubt, of an agent's session notes.

gesture.description: A user's label or park; null for now.

stale.description: Nothing but a branch, unchanged for [status] stale_days: hidden unless include_done.

changed_at.description: When its facts last changed (Unix time): the row's age.

fingerprint.description: A hash of the facts that move it across a rule.

repo.description: Only this repo's rows (the repo root's directory name).

include_done.description: Also the done (merged, closed) and stale rows.

caller.description: The asking agent's token, if any: counted, nothing else.

rows.description: Inbox first (level, blocks an agent, priority, oldest first), then in flight (ball: agent, others, stalled, done; priority; latest change first).

actionable.description: An inbox item (proposal 0013): it lives while its condition holds and resolves itself when it clears.

id.description: Stable while the condition holds, e.g. Approval:<worktree>/<agent_id>, Ci:<worktree>:<pr number>.

occurrence.description: <id>@<since>: what a dismissal hides; the same condition later is a new occurrence.

level.description: Fixed per kind. now: an agent is blocked on the user.

label.description: The agent's label, '#<n> <PR title>' or the job's title.

state.description: Its work item row's state while it is the row's top item (at most five words).

work_item.description: The status row's key; null for the orchestrator and jobs.

blocks_agent.description: An agent waits on the answer: first in its level.

priority.description: Its work item's; medium until a feeder sets one.

since.description: When the condition was first seen (Unix time).

actionable_until.description: A Unix time, or an event: ci_done (CI ran and finished), agent_stopped (an agent ran and none runs now, or one there at park time is gone), human_review (the PR's review decision changed).

repo.description: Only items of this repo's work items (the repo root's directory name).

include_hidden.description: Also the parked items (with park set).

items.description: Level (now, round), then blocks an agent, priority, oldest first.

action.description: dismiss hides this occurrence for every client; park hides the item until 'until'; unpark shows it again.

caller.description: The orchestrator's token, or none (the user); a worker's token is refused.

view.description: null until a UI has announced one.

worktree_path.description: Default: the worktree the UI shows.

agent_id.description: Omitted: the active agent tab, or the last one.

worktree_path.description: Default: the worktree the UI shows.
Default: the worktree the UI shows.

ui.blank.params.description: The hosted UI shows no worktree (a placeholder) until the next ui command, so it renders no agent: a host that shows the agents natively sends it while the hosted UI is out of sight.

worktree_path.description: Default: the worktree the UI shows. create ignores it and answers worktree_path null.

since.description: Cursor; omitted or null means from now.

statuses.description: Status values or group names (idle, blocked, finished, not_running).

truncated.description: True when events after since were already evicted.

restores.description: Present only when agents were restored after since: each engine.restored, with its seq. Engine-wide: the filters do not apply.
